instruction: Look at hard-05_base.dxf, hard-05_pin_layout.dxf, hard-05_cover.dxf. For the steps below, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-05_base.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'three-file hinge support assembly' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE, RIB. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,0)->(220,0); OUTLINE (220,0)->(220,60); OUTLINE (220,60)->(0,60); OUTLINE (0,60)->(0,0); OUTLINE (35,85)->(185,85); OUTLINE (185,85)->(185,125); OUTLINE (185,125)->(35,125); OUTLINE (35,125)->(35,85); OUTLINE (40,60)->(65,60); OUTLINE (65,60)->(65,85); OUTLINE (65,85)->(40,85); OUTLINE (40,85)->(40,60); OUTLINE (155,60)->(180,60); OUTLINE (180,60)->(180,85); OUTLINE (180,85)->(155,85); OUTLINE (155,85)->(155,60); CENTER (110,0)->(110,135); CENTER (0,30)->(220,30); CENTER (35,105)->(185,105); CUTOUT (82,110)->(138,110); CUTOUT (82,100)->(138,100). Required circles: HOLE center (25,30) radius 6; HOLE center (195,30) radius 6; HOLE center (52.5,72.5) radius 7; HOLE center (167.5,72.5) radius 7; HOLE center (110,72.5) radius 12; HOLE center (65,105) radius 5; HOLE center (155,105) radius 5. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (82,105) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (138,105) radius 5 start 270 end 90; RIB center (40,60) radius 10 start 180 end 270; RIB center (180,60) radius 10 start 270 end 0. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H05; ANNOTATION text 3-FILE ASSEMBLY. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
